item.title: CXMT Proposes Raising Share Buyback Cap to 5 Billion Yuan, Setting STAR Market Record
item.description:
CXMT's chairman proposed increasing the share buyback cap from 2 billion yuan to 5 billion yuan, setting a new record for single-instance buybacks on the STAR Market. This move comes amid stock price pressure and following a turnaround to profitability in the first three quarters, aiming to boost investor confidence and stabilize market value.

item.title: Oracle Cancels $7B Tencent AI Chip Lease After US Objections
item.description:
Oracle has cancelled a $7 billion, five-year lease with Tencent after US objections, stripping access to up to 100K advanced AI chips via Southeast Asian data centers. This move, alongside Nvidia's new resale restrictions, cuts off a critical overseas compute channel for Chinese labs and leaves Tencent facing a training capacity gap just as its Hunyuan models compete with Alibaba's Qwen.

原文标题：Oracle 因美方反对取消腾讯 70 亿美元 AI 芯片租赁协议

item.description:
Retail prices for the Nvidia RTX 5090 have surged past $9,000, significantly exceeding its launch price. This trend highlights a supply-demand imbalance in high-end AI compute hardware and rising overall GPU costs, creating substantial barriers for individual developers and small teams relying on local LLM inference.

item.description:

The initiative aims to optimize energy structures and targets a \u003e10% reduction in industrial energy intensity by 2030, directly impacting the efficiency standards and green transition of AI compute facilities.

item.title: AI Ranked Last in Voter Priorities for 2026 U.S. Midterms
item.description:
NBC News exit polls reveal that AI and data center expansion ranked last among voter priorities in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections. Despite a recent surge in public interest, only 56% of respondents deemed the issue decisive or important for their vote, significantly trailing government corruption (90%) and cost of living (89%).

item.title: Tsinghua Study Reveals Critical Failures in AI Agent Memory Deletion
item.description:
A new Tsinghua University paper reveals that AI agents with long-term memory fail to cleanly delete personal data upon user request. Testing across six memory systems showed an end-to-end success rate of less than 1.5%, with most deleted facts still extractable via simple prompts. The study urges developers to implement and verify actual deletion paths rather than relying on superficial confirmation messages.

原文标题：清华研究揭示 AI 智能体长期记忆删除机制严重失效

Why it matters：揭示了当前 AI 智能体在隐私合规与数据生命周期管理上的核心缺陷，对开发者具有极高的警示价值。

item.title: Hinton Warns AI Could Cause Major Incidents and Might Not Be Worth Developing
item.description:
Nobel laureate and AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton states that within ten years, we will know if AI risks can be managed. He warns of potential major incidents like financial or power grid shutdowns soon, suggesting humanity might have been better off without developing AI, while still acknowledging its potential for a wonderful future.

原文标题：Hinton 警告：AI 或致重大事故，人类可能本不该开发它

Why it matters：顶级 AI 先驱对技术安全性的深刻反思与具体风险预警，具有极高的行业警示意义和话题热度。

item.title: Infineon Launches First RISC-V Automotive MCU Platform AURIX RC1
item.description:
Infineon has unveiled the AURIX RC1, its first automotive microcontroller platform based on the open-standard RISC-V architecture, with samples expected in H1 2027. The platform integrates an edge AI parallel processing unit and post-quantum cryptography support to simplify software-defined vehicle development through a unified, scalable hardware foundation, backed by the DRIVECORE ecosystem for accelerated migration.

原文标题：英飞凌发布首款 RISC-V 汽车 MCU AURIX RC1

Why it matters：RISC-V 正式进入主流车规级 MCU 领域，标志着汽车芯片架构从专有转向开源的重要节点，对自动驾驶算力底座有长期影响。

item.title: Gemini Paid Users' Chat Data Used for Training Without Opt-Out
item.description:
Google Gemini personal subscription users' chat history is used for model training by default with no specific opt-out. To prevent this, users must disable 'Keep Activity,' which deletes chats after 72 hours. Additionally, some conversations are reviewed by humans and retained for up to three years, with Google explicitly warning against entering confidential information.

原文标题：Gemini 付费用户聊天数据仍用于训练且无法单独退出

Why it matters：揭示了主流 AI 产品隐私政策的重大漏洞，直接影响企业和个人用户对敏感数据的处理决策。

item.description:

Google's VP of Education claims search and AI are too fused to separate, sparking backlash from major districts like NYC and LA that previously restricted student AI use while seeking non-AI search options.

item.title: Unitree Founder Predicts Five Core Resources for Future AI Era
item.description:
Unitree Robotics founder Wang Xingxing stated at the 2026 World Internet Conference that data, computing power, chip production capacity, energy, and minerals will be the five most critical resources of the future. He also predicted next year as a potential tipping point for the robotics industry and outlined three strategic pillars: mass production scaling, physical AI small models, and ultra-large-scale computing clusters.

item.title: XPeng & Universities Release GroundingPI, Outperforming GPT-6 in Embodied Perception
item.description:
XPeng, Peking University, and HKU released GroundingPI, an embodied perception foundation model. Adopting a 'perception-first' approach trained on action-free data, it outperforms OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra across 34 benchmarks. The model aims to enhance robotic spatial grounding and reduce demonstration costs. Currently a research prototype, its code and weights are open-source.

item.title: Osewa Launches: Open-Source Terminal Protocol for AI Agents
item.description:
Osewa is an open-source terminal protocol designed for long-running AI agents, serving as a modern alternative to SSH and Mosh. By leveraging QUIC/TCP for session persistence and network roaming, it offers 8–100x faster key echo than SSH on poor networks, enabling seamless access to background agent tasks from any device.

Why it matters：解决了 AI Agent 长时间运行时的远程交互痛点，具备显著的性能优势与场景针对性。

item.description:
